meta.description: Estimate causal effects of an exposure on an outcome from GWAS summary statistics using genetic instruments and a documented sensitivity battery.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: Every reported statistic is from a named fresh run; synthetic fixtures disclose their planted values.

practice_boundaries.detail: The personal-genotype request was declined and redirected to population-level research and clinicians.

methodological_ground.detail: Fresh tests cover overlap, weak instruments, NOME, MVMR, colocalization, CAUSE and LCV boundaries.

code_usability.detail: All eight shipped R files parse and every shipped executable path has checked fresh output.

functional_suitability.note: Covers the stated two-sample, cis-MR, overlap, MVMR, pleiotropy and reporting regimes with executable paths.

reliability.note: Strong explicit thresholds and stops; long Monte-Carlo execution can still end with platform-wrapper status after output.

performance_context.note: Progressive references and scripts reduce context cost, while MR-PRESSO correctly documents a substantial runtime.

agent_usability.note: Decision tree, reference routing, outputs and common-error recovery are clear; a structured F<10 CLI warning is absent.

human_usability.note: Natural task triggers, examples and explicit n=1 escape hatch are present.

security.note: No credential exposure, raw-code evaluation or destructive operation; API authentication is disclosed.

maintainability.note: Small runnable scripts and focused references are testable; some methods remain external-package dependent.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger, reference index, safe stops and related-skill routing are strong; optional SIMEX seed slightly weakens default reproducibility.

key_strengths: Exact current source copy matched all 19 worktree files before execution.
Real 1000G EUR clumping removed the known high-LD SNP and preserved two independent instruments.
MR-PRESSO outlier extraction follows the corrected adjusted-p-value rule and captured all planted invalid loci.
The skill prevents the reproduced F-below-one qhet_mvmr sign-flip regime and handles Steiger NULL explicitly.
The compatible loo wrapper enabled a fresh complete CAUSE model comparison.

recommendations.title: Emit an explicit F below 10 CLI warning
recommendations.problem: The MVMR CLI prints conditional F=8.76/8.53 but finishes without a machine-readable weak-instrument warning.
recommendations.root_cause: The script has a hard stop below one and documentation for ten, but no runtime branch for the interval between them.
recommendations.fix: After computing condF, emit a clear warning or structured status for any 1 <= F < 10 while preserving the current hard stop below one.

recommendations.title: Make SIMEX reproducibility the default
recommendations.problem: simex_egger.R accepts a seed but leaves it unset by default, so repeated correction results can vary.
recommendations.root_cause: The optional seed is exposed but not given a reproducible default or omission warning.
recommendations.fix: Set a documented default seed or print a reproducibility warning whenever --seed is omitted.
